name: LZR 375 375 MAX GEN2 (Lazer, 375 gr)

ballisticCoefficients.note: G1 BC, printed ".860 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.
G7 BC, printed ".432 (A.B.)". Marked (A.B.): independent testing (page footnote). The velocity it applies to is not stated.

sources.note: Page 4, Lazer - Ultra Long Range Hunting: Caliber .375, Grains 375, Minimum Required Twist *1-10", Part Number LZR 375 375 MAX GEN2, G1 BC .860 (A.B.), G7 BC .432 (A.B.), OAL 2.184", Bullet Projection 1.585"

note: The twist is marked "*"; page footnote: "*If shooting through transonic, a twist rate increase of 1-2 inches faster is recommended (ex: 1:9" instead of 1:10")". Bullet projection (from the SealTite band to the tip, page footnote) printed: 1.585". The same G1 .860 and G7 .432 are printed for MTH 375 375 MAX.
